# Documentation

Keep documentation practical, specific, and synchronized with the real repository state.

## Required behavior

- update docs when setup steps, commands, or workflows change
- use real file paths and commands from the repository
- clearly mark placeholders, assumptions, and manual follow-up
- prefer short procedures, checklists, and examples over vague prose
- distinguish reusable guidance from repository-specific customization
